summary: The article provides a largely accurate and well-explained overview of India's Manufacturing PMI, its recent performance, methodology, and significance.

claims.claim: The latest S&P Global HSBC India Manufacturing PMI data for July 2026 was released on August 3, 2026.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the release date of August 3, 2026, for the July 2026 PMI data.

claims.claim: The Manufacturing PMI for July 2026 stood at 53.5, which is lower than June's 54.2.
claims.note: Numerous sources confirm these exact figures for July and June 2026.

claims.claim: This marks the slowest growth since August 2021.
claims.note: Multiple sources corroborate that the July 2026 PMI reading of 53.5 is the lowest since August 2021.

claims.claim: The index is compiled by S&P Global from responses to questionnaires sent to purchasing managers in around 400 manufacturers.
claims.note: S&P Global, in partnership with HSBC, compiles the India Manufacturing PMI from a panel of around 400 manufacturers.

claims.claim: The key components are New Orders (30%), Output (25%), Employment (20%), Suppliers' Delivery Times (15%), and Stock of Items Purchased (10%).
claims.note: The article correctly lists the five components and their respective weightages.
